# fimea-email (PHAROS fixture)

Fimea (Finland) publishes in Finnish and Swedish at https://fimea.fi, which sits behind a Cloudflare
bot check. PHAROS never tries to pass a bot check, so the site was not requested at all on 4 November 2026.
Fimea is read from its e-mail newsletters (`inbound_email`, parser `email_inbox`); titles stay in
Finnish/Swedish exactly as sent. No message has been received yet, so there is no fixture message.
